name: webex-messaging-mcp
description: Read, search, and post Webex messages from your editor via Cisco's hosted Webex Messaging MCP server.

webex_client_id.title: Webex Integration Client ID
webex_client_id.description: From developer.webex.com/my-apps → your Integration → Client ID.

webex_callback_port.title: OAuth callback port
webex_callback_port.description: Local port Claude Code listens on during sign-in. Must match the Redirect URI you registered: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback. Change it only if 35621 is already in use on your machine.

webex_scopes.title: Webex scopes to request
webex_scopes.description: Space-separated, and must be a subset of the scopes on your Integration or sign-in fails with invalid_scope. Rather than editing this by hand, run the webex-mcp-setup skill and pick the capabilities you need from a checklist — it writes this field for you.

webex_disclaimer.title: AI disclaimer appended to outgoing messages
webex_disclaimer.description: Added in italics on its own line at the end of every message this server posts. Leave empty to disable. Only applies if you granted a message-write scope.
webex_disclaimer.default: This message was generated using AI and posted using the Webex MCP server. Apologies in advance for any errors or omissions
